sources.title: Embassy of the State of Eritrea: passport application form

sources.title: Cuba Travel: Regulations for travelling to Cuba
sources.officialityEvidence: Cuba's official tourism portal gives tourist-entry rules, names the visa-exempt Chinese-citizen exception and makes the electronic tourist-visa route available through the Internet worldwide except the United States.
sources.supportingExcerpt: It is requested ... through the Internet from anywhere in the world (except the United States).

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 Tourism (F5A) visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document defines F5A tourism eligibility for citizens of all countries, its online process, and delivery of a visa certificate by email.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire official SNEDAI: e-visa procedure
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, official Côte d'Ivoire visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: SNEDAI identifies itself as Côte d'Ivoire's only State-approved visa-application website, limits the online process to valid ordinary-passport holders, and states that the visa is printed and issued at the airport after approval.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La demande en ligne du E-visa est valable uniquement pour les détenteurs de passeports ordinaires.

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire Ministry of Foreign Affairs: advice for travellers
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, African Integration and the Diaspora, Côte d'Ivoire
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Côte d'Ivoire MFA traveller guidance sets the visitor document baseline and directs visitors to the SNEDAI visa route or a conditional airport-visa route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Passeport valide plus de 6 mois et visa requis (demande en ligne via le portail officiel de Snedai ou visa aéroportuaire sous conditions).

sources.title: Ukraine MFA: entry regime for Eritrean travel passports
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine
sources.officialityEvidence: Ukraine MFA's current country-and-travel-document table records Eritrea: visa and says applicants required to have an entry visa apply through the relevant Ukrainian embassy or consulate; its e-Visa route is expressly only for eligible countries.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Eritrea | visa ... Every foreigner ... required to have an entry Ukrainian visa may apply ... to the relevant Ukraine's Embassy or Consulate.

policies.title: Eritrean ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's current official tourism guidance requires a tourist visa for a non-resident Eritrean visitor and makes its electronic tourist-visa route available online worldwide except in the United States.
conditions: Use an Eritrean ordinary passport. Cuba names Chinese citizens as visa-exempt; a non-resident Eritrean visitor must obtain the tourist visa.
Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel. Cuba's D'Viajeros declaration is separate; the tourist visa is single-entry for up to 90 days, with a possible 90-day extension.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules, Eritrean departure formalities and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Obtain the electronic tourist visa before departure using the Eritrean ordinary passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration as required.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Eritrean ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service makes an online, emailed tourism visa available to citizens of all countries, subject to the stated waiver exceptions and ordinary passport validity.
conditions: Use a valid Eritrean ordinary passport with at least six months' validity, photo, return ticket and the listed supporting evidence. F5A is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days.

Apply online, upload documents and pay the fee. Nigeria Immigration Service says the applicant receives the visa certificate by email; this is electronic issuance, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.

The source excepts ECOWAS member States and countries with a visa-waiver agreement. It does not identify an Eritrean ordinary-passport exception. Work, residence, special passports, carrier rules, Eritrean departure formalities and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service eVisa service
steps: Apply online using the Eritrean ordinary passport and upload the required tourism documents.
Pay the fee and await the emailed visa certificate before travel.
Use the electronic certificate subject to carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Eritrean ordinary passports: Côte d'Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Côte d'Ivoire's State-approved ordinary-passport process gives online preapproval and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: Complete pre-enrolment, payment and document upload; board only with the approved D.S.T. response, payment receipt, valid Eritrean ordinary passport and yellow-fever certificate.
At Abidjan airport complete biometric enrolment; the visa is printed and issued there. This is online preapproval followed by border issuance, not an eVisa.
Work, residence, special passports, carrier rules, Eritrean departure formalities and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Côte d'Ivoire official e-visa pre-enrolment
steps: Wait for the D.S.T. approved response before boarding.
Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued.

policies.title: Eritrean ordinary passports: Ukraine advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Ukraine MFA's travel-passport table requires a visa for Eritrean citizens, and its current visa guidance routes required-visa applicants to Ukrainian embassies or consulates before travel.
conditions: Apply to the relevant Ukrainian embassy or consulate before travel; this is an advance consular route, not an eVisa or visa-on-arrival classification.
War-related border, air-access, occupied-territory permit, carrier, Eritrean departure and final-admission conditions remain separate from this visa classification.

conflicts.explanation: Côte d'Ivoire's official ordinary-passport procedure requires approved online pre-enrolment before travel but prints and issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
